observations: Treatment recovered a valid three-file selection while control selected no context; the treatment native score had 0.75 file coverage and 1.0 file precision.

The treatment state measured 286 tokens and 726 bytes. Replacing the registered control messages still left the treatment first request 28 input tokens larger, rather than at least 128 tokens smaller.

Both branches made exactly one post-fork model call and total treatment cost exceeded control by only 124 tokens, so the failure is isolated to representation cost rather than exploration amplification.

The full 64-character evidence identifiers are a major irreducible part of the current state and output interface. External short handles can preserve exact internal bindings without making the model copy full identifiers.
inference: Terminal evidence remains a plausible quality mechanism, but JSON field names and full evidence identifiers consume too much prompt space. The next hypothesis should test a reversible external handle dictionary: present short handles plus paths, accept those handles in the terminal tool, and resolve them deterministically to exact delivered read IDs before export.

selected_successor.name: token-efficient evidence handles
selected_successor.mechanism: At the held terminal boundary, assign deterministic short handles to up to three receipt-bound evidence records. Treatment receives a compact handle/path list and a terminal schema that accepts only those handles. The runtime resolves them to full delivered read IDs before native export.

alternatives.name: single full evidence identifier
alternatives.disposition: simpler prompt, but likely sacrifices the three-file coverage signal and remains hash-token expensive

alternatives.name: additive terminal state
alternatives.disposition: quality mechanism retained, but contradicted by the non-increasing-token objective

alternatives.name: no transferable terminal-state gain
alternatives.disposition: retained until the handle representation either preserves or loses the observed completion signal

open_questions: Can a three-handle prompt and tool schema reduce the exact provider-tokenized first request by at least 128 tokens?
Can handle resolution remain one-to-one, receipt-bound, and impossible to invent?
Does path plus line range preserve enough semantic information without full read IDs?
Will the valid-selection advantage survive on a fresh fixed cohort?
